                      完整的职位描述

                      Position Type
                      Full Time
                      Career area
                      Business Operations
                      Location
                      17-18F Agile Center, Guangzhou, Guangdong 510000, Mainland China
                      Job ID
                      R-82313


                      Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

                      NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

                      WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

                      Nike moves fast, and this role supports teams to focus, connect, and do their best work. As the Lead Office Administrator, you will work closely with your manager, functional leaders and employees across three China Footwear PMOs, serving as a trusted partner and go-to contact for daily office operations. You will manage supply & resources, support clear communication, and help create a connected and efficient working environment that reflects the best of Nike’s culture.

                      WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

                      Your role provides general Admin support to all employees, which primary includes but not limited to the following:

                      • Vehicle: Managing office vehicles including shuttles to manufacturing partners. Co-ordinating communications with leasing companies and drivers. Monitoring vehicle conditions and driver performance.
                      • Procurement: Sourcing office supplies like stationaries etc. to support the business needs of employees.
                      • Travel: Supporting employees with visa applications and other travel-related inquiries. Helping visitors to grant China visas and arrange on-site transportation.
                      • Third-party Invoice Processing: Preparing payment requests of PMO vendors and GPS related. Collaborating with Accounting team on payment tracking.
                      • Office Events: Playing a key role in organizing/supporting company events like Annual Party, JDI Day, sports activities and community events.
                      • Company License: Renewing company licenses and certificates for three Footwear PMOs. Co-ordinating renewal and validation of other company legal documents.

                      WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

                      • Bachelor's degree in business or related field. Minimum of 5 years of administrative work experience
                      • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Chinese
                      • Ability to work and communicate effectively with diverse personalities
                      • Proactive and structured team player
                      • Ability to work independently, pay attention to details and take initiative to follow-through on requests
                      • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (MS Outlook, PowerPoint, Word and Excel)
                      • Ability to occasionally work outside of core business hours

                      NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete* in the world.

                      NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

                      What You Can Expect

                      OUR HIRING GAME PLAN

                      01 Apply

                      Our teams are made up of diverse skillsets, knowledge bases, inputs, ideas and backgrounds. We want you to find your fit – review job descriptions, departments and teams to discover the role for you.

                      02 Meet a Recruiter or Take an Assessment

                      If selected for a corporate role, a recruiter will reach out to start your interview process and be your main contact throughout the process. For retail roles, you’ll complete an interactive assessment that includes a chat and quizzes and takes about 10-20 minutes to complete. No matter the role, we want to learn about you – the whole you – so don’t shy away from how you approach world-class service and what makes you unique.

                      03 Interview

                      Go into this stage confident by doing your research, understanding what we are looking for and being prepared for questions that are set up to learn more about you, and your background.
